This article is a stub. The Counsilman Company, Inc. of Bloomington, Indiana, sold James
Counsilman's stroke-analysis films, isokinetic exercisers and swimming manual by mail from 1972,
after his own advertisements for the [Counsilman Pace Clock](../equipment/common/pace-clock/counsilman-pace-clock.md)
had ended.

See the [vendors overview](index.md) for the other companies this wiki covers.
